acceptanceCriteria: an owner-recorded rule for post-seal acceptance commits, reflected in docs/DOGFOOD.md
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 merge queue. PRs #218, #219, #222 and #223 received decision and acceptance commits after their dogfood seal, so those commits are outside the bound CEM. Decide whether acceptance edits need rebinding, a documented exemption, or a lighter addendum binding.
title: dogfood: owner-acceptance commits pushed after dogfood-seal are not bound by the change's CEM
